the outer-membrane protein profiles of the bacteria isolated from the lungs of calves infected experimentally with P. haemolytica are different from the profiles of bacteria grown in vitro under iron sufficient conditions and different from the profiles from bacteria grown in diffusion chambers implanted in the peritoneal cavity of calves.
the OMP profiles of P. haemolytica grown in vivo were different from those of bacteria grown in vitro.
the OMP profile of P. haemolytica grown in vitro under iron-restricted conditions is different from that of the bacterium grown in vivo in the bovine lung, although some similarities exist.
